name: bnpl-schedule-check
title: BNPL Schedule Check
description: Draws each payment on a calendar beside other plans and paydays, flags a card that expires before a payment, payments just before payday and plans stacking in one week, offers one-tap fixes, shows the late fee in money and asks for a second press while the card problem stands.

meta.stops: Instalment fails on an expired card
mistakes: too many pay later plans at once
meta.summary: Lays out buy-now-pay-later payments on a calendar with paydays and other plans, so an instalment doesn't fail on an expired card or before payday.
meta.server: The provider's schedule, fees and card on file are the source of truth; re-check them on the server before confirming.
catches: A card that expires before a scheduled payment
Payments due shortly before payday (gap set by payGapDays)
Several plans charging in the same week
The late fee and its cap, shown in money
limits: Paydays, other plans, the card expiry and the late-fee rule all come from your props
Moving a payment only changes the proposed date; the provider must allow it
a11y: The card problem is announced with role="alert"
Payment source is a role="radiogroup" with arrow-key navigation
Confirm sets aria-busy while pending; status is announced in a role="status" region
Issues use text and icons; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
